subject: Request: temporary demo guardrail / short extension while PO clears
messages:
From: Meagan Ortiz <meagan.ortiz@beaconhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Demo time at risk — procurement taking longer than expected

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — procurement at Beacon has hit an extra review because we have to route through a new security intake for external vendors. The team expects the PO in ~10 business days, but our pilot credits expire in 3 business days and the demo environment will shut down.

Is there any way Redwood can keep the environment alive (or extend the trial window) for a short period while the legal/finance loop completes? We’re committed — the PO is in the queue (attached a copy of the PO draft) — but I need to avoid the team losing momentum.

Attachment: PO_draft_BCN-6912.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)

Appreciate any help you can provide — I’m happy to share the procurement contact if that helps.

Best,
Meagan Ortiz
Senior Product Manager, Beacon Health
meagan.ortiz@beaconhealth.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Meagan Ortiz <meagan.ortiz@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo time at risk — procurement taking longer than expected

Hi Meagan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely help avoid a hard stop while procurement finishes. I can approve a short, administrative extension for the demo window and provision a small buffer of complimentary run-time credits to keep tests and workflows active. A couple quick asks so we document this correctly:

- Can you confirm the expected PO finalization date (best estimate)?
- Are there any compliance docs (SOC2 / DPA) still outstanding on Beacon's side?
- Does procurement require an invoice / billing contact we should route to for faster processing?

I’m looping Marissa (Sales Ops) to document the extension and Camila (your AE) to track credits and follow the PO. I’ll attach a short one-page extension acknowledgement we ask the customer to countersign in DocuSign — purely administrative.

What I’m prepared to offer now: 7 calendar days of trial extension + a 3000-token complimentary credit pool to keep integration tests live. If Beacon needs slightly more runway pending the PO, we can revisit once you share the procurement ETA.

Attachment: trial-extension-terms.pdf (application/pdf, 8KB)

If that sounds okay, reply with the PO ETA and I’ll mark it as approved.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Healthcare
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Meagan Ortiz <meagan.ortiz@beaconhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo time at risk — procurement taking longer than expected

Thanks, Soojin — that is hugely helpful and exactly what we needed to avoid losing momentum.

Estimated PO finalization: procurement says ~10 business days from today (so roughly Jan 6). The outstanding items are the vendor security attestation and an updated billing contact (I’ll pull both threads this morning and copy you).

A 7-day extension + the 3000-token buffer will get the engineers through the critical end-to-end checks today and tomorrow — I’ll check if we can compress procurement, but plan is the PO will be signed.

Can you confirm whether the extension needs a countersignature or if your team will accept an email confirmation? If you need the DocuSign I can route it to our legal and get back quickly.

Appreciate everyone’s help — I’ll follow up with the procurement contact in case they need any materials from Redwood.

Best,
Meagan
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Approve temporary demo guardrail for Beacon Health (DEAL-6912)

Marissa / Camila — per the thread below with Meagan at Beacon, I approved an administrative 7-day extension and a 3000-token credit pool to keep the pilot environment live while procurement finishes.

Please do the following:
- Marissa: record the extension in the deal notes, upload the attached trial-extension-terms.pdf to the HubSpot record, and flag for finance review. We’ll move to DocuSign only if Beacon requests it — Meagan is checking today.
- Camila: once Marissa confirms the extension is documented, please provision the 3000-token credit and set expiration to 2027-01-04T23:59:00-08:00. If Beacon provides a firm PO ETA longer than the 7 days, escalate to me and we’ll review additional runway.

I’ve included the PO draft that Meagan sent earlier in the thread for reference.

Thanks — good win to keep momentum during the holidays.

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Healthcare
Redwood Inference
